description: This data set records how specimens from patients and animals were carried from local health facilities to testing laboratories during a pilot of a shared specimen transport system in Vietnam. The producers are the non-profit PATH with Vietnam's Department of Animal Health and National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology, in the Infectious Disease Detection and Surveillance project funded by USAID. Coverage is 78 human and animal health facilities in Thai Nguyen, Binh Dinh and Dong Thap provinces, from June 2022 to December 2023; specimens moved from district hospitals and health centres to provincial laboratories and, when needed, to regional and national laboratories, mostly by a contracted courier. Each record gives dispatch and receipt dates and times, the number of packages and specimens, and whether delivery met the system's time criteria. The workbook is available as a free download from Dryad, mirrored on Zenodo, under the CC0 dedication. Caveats: a pilot in three provinces, facility names may be coded, and biosafety compliance is summarised in the related article, not fully in the file. Simulation uses: modelling laboratory referral networks and turnaround times, and testing how outbreaks or road disruption delay diagnosis. Related records: the Freiburg hospital logistics network (data-freiburg-hospital-logistics-network) covers transport inside a hospital.
name: Integrated specimen referral system pilot in three provinces of Vietnam for human and animal health (2022-2023)
